within_page_test: All non-anchor f49v rows whose marginal sign is in the fixed map; no unknown sign receives a guessed value.
external_alignment: An L0 locus directly followed by a P0 locus; infer only that local pairing, not a whole-column row correspondence.
excluded_alignment_reason: 34 isolated signs and 32 running text lines; unequal lengths and source warning about changing alignment. No index-based pairing permitted.
drawing_gap_sensitivity: full: drawing breaks delimit tokens; left: only text before first drawing break. Neither is a translated-word count.
zodiac_primary_normalization: Drop inline editorial comments; require lowercase a-z and dot-separated words only; preserve word boundaries as spaces. Reject uncertainty, rare-code, ligature, comma and alternate-reading syntax.
zodiac_sensitivity_normalization: Same eligibility rule; then remove word spaces, without selecting cases to improve results.
zodiac_model_under_test: A context-free deterministic canonical full-label representation of distinct ordinal values at the 30 positions of each complete sign. Aries and Taurus form paired 15-unit halves. This model predicts no repeated complete numeral label within each sign and the same label set across signs with complete 30-label coverage.
zodiac_order_free_bound: For each sign pair, multiset intersection of eligible labels is the maximum number of identical labels alignable under ANY permutation. Report eligible coverage and omitted labels; low overlap alone is not conclusive if exclusions are numerous.
zodiac_complete_overlap_bound: Use all raw exact labels as an additional descriptive view; for strict eligible labels, add both sides' excluded counts to the shared-label upper bound, capped at smaller complete list size. This is deliberately generous and is not a fitted score.
known_before_test: The f49v seed associations and their anchor-row word counts were already examined.
A repeated otaly label in f73r was noticed during the previous inventory; the cross-sign duplicate audit is not a new blind discovery.
The complete corpus has been used in earlier experiments; these checks are not a fresh independent dataset.
decision_rule: Contradictions restrict the explicit simple models only. Do not promote a surviving interpretation to a translation; do not add aliases, rotations, filters or a new key after inspecting results.
